description: Navigate to the 'Chronos' activity in GCompris (found in the Discovery/History category). Select the 'Transportation' theme (or 'Plants' if Transportation is unavailable). You will see a set of shuffled images representing a timeline (e.g., evolution of flight or plant growth). Drag and drop the images to arrange them in the correct chronological order from left to right (oldest to newest). When correctly ordered, a success animation will appear. Take a screenshot of the completed state.
